title: In-app guided room capture (ARKit poses + depth, coverage, blur, quality gate)
summary: Room walkthrough capture in the app: record video with ARKit camera poses and depth, live coverage and speed coaching, blur rejection, and a pre-upload quality gate, producing an upload bundle for reconstruction. Coaching UI follows DESIGN_SYSTEM §6 once locked.

acceptance_tests.test: A capture session records video plus per-frame ARKit poses and available depth into a bundle matching the upload contract in services/reconstruction; a session over a real room produces a valid bundle.
acceptance_tests.evidence: clip + a sample bundle manifest in the PR

acceptance_tests.test: Coverage feedback, a speed meter, blur rejection, and a pre-upload 'missed corner' hint are present and driven by the capture, per DESIGN_SYSTEM §6.
A quality gate blocks upload on too-dark or too-fast captures with a kind, actionable message; the player can retake; nothing hard-crashes.
GPS and EXIF are stripped on device before the bundle is written; the bundle carries no location metadata.
Active capture stays under 90 s on a normal room; measured on the Owner's iPhone.
